company.name: Tailor
company.shortDescription: Tailor is a no-code headless ERP platform helping retail businesses unify tools, marketplaces, and teams on one system.
company.description: Tailor is a Headless ERP that enables businesses to create their own customized ERP with no coding.

productsAndServices.description: A modular, API-first ERP for retail, ecommerce, omnichannel, B2B, DTC, and manufacturing operations. It unifies orders, inventory, procurement, production, warehousing, and cost accounting.
productsAndServices.name: Tailor Headless Composable ERP

productsAndServices.description: A low-code, developer-oriented platform for creating customizable headless business applications, APIs, data models, workflows, and integrations without building backend infrastructure from scratch.
productsAndServices.name: Tailor Platform

productsAndServices.description: A retail inventory management module for real-time stock visibility, inventory costing, demand forecasting, replenishment, and stock movement across channels and locations.
productsAndServices.name: Inventory Management

productsAndServices.description: A centralized order management module for coordinating ecommerce, marketplace, POS, in-store, wholesale, and B2B orders with configurable fulfillment, pricing, returns, and routing workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Omnichannel Order Management

productsAndServices.description: A procurement module for supplier management, purchase order creation, demand-based replenishment, shipment and invoice matching, and purchasing workflow automation.
productsAndServices.name: Purchase Management

productsAndServices.description: A manufacturing operations module for make-to-stock, make-to-order, job shop, and batch production, including bills of materials, work orders, resource planning, costing, and quality workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Production Management

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $15,000,000, or 36.32% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $24,305,104 to $154,304,738, a 6.35x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 85 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 25 (-14).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
